window.scope: Existing complete100 stochastic training/DR window; no new event parse or outcome inference

scope_definitions.gate_fractions: Per strategy frame: sum(holding_rl & gate_pass)/max(sum(holding_rl),1); reported window is mean of rollout scalar means. Holding population changes with phase.
scope_definitions.support_and_body_clear: Encoder/IMU observer estimates, not true wheel contacts or collision-free evidence
scope_definitions.stable_peak_and_break: Per-frame mean over all4096 lanes, followed by rollout/window means; lifetime-since-reset states, not window increments or means over ended episodes
scope_definitions.hold_cost_mask: recovery_enabled & whole_interval_actor_owned & begin_policy_motion_hold; includes first-release interval and actor-caused terminal, does not require1s stable
scope_definitions.hold_cost_state: Physical-endstate dq/omega; differs from observer FSM feedback and end-frame holding mask
scope_definitions.logger_identity_limit: 24-frame rollout averaging is supported by saved RSL logger snapshot; current external runtime logger byte identity was not independently pinned by this window raw

FSM_release.clock: 5ms feedback ticks; consecutive200 ticks, reset if any predicate fails

gates.valid: Finite sensor values and valid gravity vector

FSM_release.scope: RL owns after blend;1s holds followup motion commands, not initial actor handoff

physical_true_success.before_release: Pure RL + true dual contacts + no undesired contact + target platform + tilt<12deg + horizontal gyro norm<.75 + actual height error<=.05m + planar speed<.25 for1s
physical_true_success.after_release: Same physical stability plus abs(vx-goal)<=.12 and abs(yaw_rate-goal)<=.2 for1s; standing also planar speed<.10; prior1s truth evidence and no failure required
physical_true_success.premature_release: First observed FSM release without prior1s physical stability is a distinct failure
physical_true_success.scope: Separate physical truth from observer release; existing marginal scalars cannot locate mismatches

native_density_probe.scope: Actual frozen dense_error_terms CPU float64/autograd only; no Env, PPO, rollout, or performance qualification

findings: Hold wheel/leg/gyro densities are logged with nonzero negative means; existing code pays costs before the1s release gate. Missing payment is not supported.
Support/body-clear and wheel-speed have the largest instantaneous marginal nonpasses in holding_rl; they are priorities for joint trace, not causal attribution.
.274s and31.84 are all-lane/window averages and cannot be described as per-ended-episode peaks/breaks or pureL2 outcomes.
Fine wheel precision is near saturation at its release threshold, but broad cost retains error discrimination; derivative sign is not a PPO learning guarantee or proof weight is sufficient.
The mature lesson probabilities stayed.20/.30/.50 in the compared windows. Existing mixed completion change cannot be attributed to a between-window lesson-share switch.
minimal_next_evidence: On one unchanged-model holding trajectory, align5ms gate conjunction and dwell reset with estimated support/body_clear, true contacts, dq/gyro, and20ms actor ownership/begin-policy hold-cost mask. No contract change based only on marginal means.
